Class StorageStackBE

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.StackBlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.StorageStackBE
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.core.TypedInstance<net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType<?>>, net.minecraft.util.debug.DebugValueSource
public class StorageStackBE extends StackBlockEntity
One Storage Stack: 27 item stacks drawn as a 3 x 3 x 3 grid.

The block owns its own slots, but it is not the unit of storage. A vertical run of these is a StoragePile, and deposits, capability access, sorting and packing all act on the whole run. Everything here that reaches past this block's own slots resolves the pile first.

Automation exposure is loader-specific and lives outside this class: NeoForge uses a transactional resource capability and Fabric the Transfer API. StackBlockEntity.getItems() is the local storage each loader-specific whole-pile view adapts.

    • pile

      @Nullable public StoragePile pile()
      The pile this block belongs to, or null on the client and for a block being removed.

      Resolved once a tick and held. A machine reading this block's item handler resolves the pile once per slot it walks, which is hundreds of times a tick for one attached storage network, and the run cannot change between two of those reads without passing through the block's own place or remove hook. Those hooks drop the cache; the tick it was taken on is what drops it for anything that edits the world without them.
